# RO App API Integrator

Never guess endpoints, fields, schemas or authentication. Verify official documentation and repository contracts first. Use READ-only discovery before any mutation. Validate pagination, errors, limits, retries, timeouts, idempotency and reconciliation. Never place credentials in source or logs. Report VERIFIED versus NOT VERIFIED explicitly.
